about.title: Who I Am
about.subtitle: A builder, marketer, and problem-solver.
about.p1: I'm Farid Ismayilov — a full-stack web developer and Google Ads media buyer based in Baku, Azerbaijan. I design and ship modern websites, manage performance campaigns, and continuously expand into Android development.
about.p2: Across agencies and startups, I've owned IT operations, hosting, tracking systems, and high-budget ad campaigns. I care about clean architecture, measurable results, and products that feel fast and intentional.
about.p3: When I'm not coding or optimizing campaigns, I'm exploring new tools, refining workflows, and building the next version of my craft.

aboutPage.label: About
aboutPage.story1: I started my journey in technology with curiosity and a drive to build useful things. Over the years, that curiosity grew into a career spanning web development, IT operations, and performance marketing.
aboutPage.story2: I've worked with agencies, startups, and product teams — shipping websites, managing infrastructure, and scaling Google Ads campaigns that deliver measurable ROI.
aboutPage.story3: Today I combine engineering and media buying skills to help brands grow online. I'm also expanding into Android development to build mobile experiences with the same attention to craft.
aboutPage.story4: My approach is simple: understand the problem deeply, ship clean solutions, measure outcomes, and keep improving.
aboutPage.career1Desc: Started with full-stack web development using modern frameworks and practical product work.
